module: LFP 25.6 V 50 Ah (8 prismatic cells in series)

aging._models: naumann_sony = TU Munich data (Naumann et al. 2018/2020), src/aging_naumann.py, default; nrel_prismatic = NREL BLAST-Lite large prismatic cells, src/aging_nrel.py
aging.units: naumann_sony: k_cal per sqrt(s), Ea in J/mol, cycle law in % per sqrt(FEC); nrel_prismatic: k_cal per day^p_cal, T in K, Ua in V, k_cyc per EFC^p_cyc

sources.aging: naumann_sony (default): Naumann et al., J. Energy Storage 17 (2018) 153-169, doi:10.1016/j.est.2018.01.019 (calendar) and J. Power Sources 451 (2020) 227666 (cycle); coefficients as in the authors' SimSES code, checked by src/validate_aging.py. nrel_prismatic: NREL BLAST-Lite v1.1.1 lfp_gr_250AhPrismatic_2019, data in J. Energy Storage doi:10.1016/j.est.2023.109042; checked by src/validate_aging_nrel.py. The default is the faster-fading (conservative) model.
sources.degradation_scalar: 1.0 = the premium cell tested by NREL. Low-cost modules sold off-grid usually age faster; 2.0 is used as a sensitivity case, not a measured value.
sources.graphite_potential: Safari & Delacourt, J. Electrochem. Soc. 158(5) A562 (2011), doi:10.1149/1.3567007
sources.efficiency: LFP coulombic and voltage efficiency at low C-rate, round trip ~94%. TO CONFIRM with module datasheet.
sources.max_c_rate: Conservative continuous rate for a home LFP module; our peak use is 0.07 C.
sources.soc_window: Standard controller uses 10-100% SoC (LVD at 10% to protect the cells).
sources.temp_offset_c: Battery indoors in a Maiduguri house: assumed 3 C above outdoor air on average (sheet-metal roofs, thermal mass). TO CONFIRM; sensitivity tested in validate_aging.py.
sources.r_th_k_per_w: Module-to-room thermal resistance, natural convection: h ~ 5-10 W/m2K over ~0.3 m2 gives 0.3-0.7 K/W. Self-heating is small at 0.1 C (~1-2 C).
